rationale: Price is sitting just below the 9-EMA ($62.51) with the last five 1-minute candles showing a clear rollover from ~$62.79 down to $62.45, suggesting near-term selling pressure. With 116 minutes to close and no clear momentum confirmation in either direction, skipping preserves capital.
